# Hyunseob Baik

<p class="hero-lede">Geological Remote Sensing · Hyperspectral Imaging · LiDAR–HSI Fusion · Planetary Geology</p>

I am a postdoctoral researcher at the Mineral Exploration and Mining Research Center, Korea Institute of Geoscience and Mineral Resources (KIGAM). My work combines hyperspectral imaging, LiDAR, and geospatial analysis to map geological materials in underground, terrestrial, satellite, and planetary settings.

## Research focus

::: {.research-grid}
::: {.research-card}
### Underground sensing

Hyperspectral and LiDAR observations for spatially complex underground geological environments.

[Research theme](research.qmd#underground-hyperspectrallidar-remote-sensing)
:::

::: {.research-card}
### Mineral mapping

VNIR–SWIR analysis, spectral target detection, and integration of laboratory, field, and satellite observations.

[Research theme](research.qmd#hyperspectral-mineral-mapping)
:::

::: {.research-card}
### Planetary geology & rover payloads

Orbital remote sensing and rover-mounted payloads for mineral mapping, geological observation, and lunar and Martian exploration.

[Research theme](research.qmd#planetary-geology-and-remote-sensing)
:::

::: {.research-card}
### Robotic near-field sensing

Ongoing rover and robotic-platform research for near-field remote sensing in underground mines and surface outcrops.

[Research theme](research.qmd#robotic-near-field-geological-remote-sensing)
:::
:::
